title: A call is attributed only by evidence: two agents named for one run are CONFLICTING, and nothing is guessed
goal: settle() comes to its word by the ordered table -- CONFLICTING whenever two different agents are named for one run, by any mix of what the hooks observed and what somebody reported, then HOST_OBSERVED, then REPORTED, then UNATTRIBUTED -- names every agent it was told and chooses none of them, counts an empty id as no id, and moves nothing onto a latest skill, a nearest run or a closest timestamp; and envelopeRefOf() reads the qualified run reference off a text only when it carries the envelope's mark and exactly one mission and one run, well-formed, within what it scans
reproduce: every failing check names what was observed and reported, or the text it read, the word or reference the contract expects and what came back; the probe imports the subject's own attribution module and answers in its own process
